snippet.title: Bastion Rivals — Build an army they can't counter
snippet.description:
Defend both lanes. Destroy the enemy castle.
Choose melee, ranged, flying and siege units to counter your rival.
Equip your builder, upgrade your army and stop a breakthrough with a Rescue Strike.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5423790/Bastion_Rivals/

Bastion Rivals is inspired by Castle Fight, the Warcraft III custom map originally created by geX (gekko). Thanks to geX and the Castle Fight community.
